# Protocol spec

<!-- Generated by packages/protocol/src/spec.test.ts. Don't edit this file. Regenerate: bun --bun vitest run -u packages/protocol -->

This page lists the frames that the server and its clients exchange, for protocol version 1. A test generates it from the schemas in [`packages/protocol/src`](https://github.com/jcore9/Aphelion/tree/dev/packages/protocol/src) and fails when this page is out of date. [The client protocol](protocol.md) explains replay, resync and command ids.

## Envelope

Every frame is one JSON object with these fields. A frame with a field that its type doesn't list is rejected.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `v` | `1` | yes | The protocol version. |
| `type` | `"command"` or `"resume"` or `"result"` or `"event"` or `"resync"` or `"error"` | yes | The frame type. |

## Frames a client sends

### `command` frame

Asks the server to run a command.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`CommandId`](#commandid) | yes | The client picks it. A retry sends the same id. |
| `name` | `"ping"` | yes | The command to run. |
| `payload` | object | yes | The command's input. |

### `resume` frame

Asks for the events the client missed.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | [`Cursor`](#cursor) or `null` | yes | The client's position, or null when it has none. |

## Frames the server sends

### `result` frame

Answers a command that succeeded.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`CommandId`](#commandid) | yes | The id of the command this frame answers. |
| `name` | `"ping"` | yes | The command that ran. |
| `result` | object | yes | The command's output. |

### `event` frame

Tells every client that something happened.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `seq` | integer, at least 1 | yes | The event's number in the stream. |
| `name` | `"notice"` | yes | The kind of event. |
| `payload` | object | yes | What happened. |

### `resync` frame

Tells a client that it can't catch up.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | [`Cursor`](#cursor) | yes | Where the client continues after it reloads. |

### `error` frame

Rejects a frame.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | `"malformed"` or `"unsupported-version"` | yes | Why the frame was rejected. |
| `message` | string | yes | Fixed text that is safe to log. |
| `id` | [`CommandId`](#commandid) | no | The rejected command's id, when it had a valid one. |

## Commands

A `command` frame carries a command's `payload`, and the `result` frame that answers it carries the command's `result`.

### `ping` command

`payload` has no fields, so it is `{}`.

`result` has no fields, so it is `{}`.

## Events

An `event` frame carries the event's `payload`.

### `notice` event

A message for every client to show.

`payload` has these fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | string | yes | Text for a person to read. |

## Shared types

### `CommandId`

Names one command. The client picks it, and a retry sends the same id.

It is a string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$`.

### `Cursor`

A position in an event stream.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stream` | [`StreamId`](#streamid) | yes | The stream that the position is in. |
| `seq` | integer, at least 0 | yes | The last sequence number the client has seen. |

### `StreamId`

Names one event stream. A server that restarts starts a new stream.

It is a string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$`.

## Error codes

An `error` frame's `code` is one of these. [The client protocol](protocol.md#errors) explains each one.

- `malformed`
- `unsupported-version`

## JSON Schema

[`client-frame.schema.json`](https://github.com/jcore9/Aphelion/blob/dev/packages/protocol/client-frame.schema.json) describes the frames a client sends, and [`server-frame.schema.json`](https://github.com/jcore9/Aphelion/blob/dev/packages/protocol/server-frame.schema.json) describes the frames the server sends. Both are JSON Schema draft-07, generated by the same test. Use them to check frames, or to generate types, in another language.
